summary: fix(settings): stop reporting Nimbus fetch network failures to Sentry
description:
Because:

* Client network failures of the Nimbus experiments fetch fill Sentry
  with a TypeError that the app code cannot fix.

This commit:

* Leaves a Sentry breadcrumb, not an exception, when the fetch rejects
  with a TypeError.
* Keeps the Sentry report for every other error, such as a JSON parse
  failure.

Closes FXA-8385
